props.classMechanic_text:
REAPER’S DIRGE

GATHERING SOULS

Reapers fuel their dread powers through the harvest of souls. Whenever you reduce a creature to 0 HP, you advance your 【Collected Soul】 clock by 1 section. This represents the essence of the fallen being bound to your will. The clock begins once you acquire 【Soulkeeper’s Rite】, and its maximum number of sections equals 6 by default.

Each section of the clock is a fragment of death’s toll, a resource you can spend to empower devastating techniques or to weave your 【Reaper’s Dirge】. Unlike other resources, Collected Souls do not recover naturally; they must be claimed from the slain.

SPENDING SOULS

Collected Souls are consumed to unleash the Reaper’s most fearsome abilities:

  • Unleash Death: Spend Souls to empower Dirge skills such as Corpse Explosion, Death’s Shadow, or Twilight Requiem, dealing massive Dark damage or twisting the battlefield with dread effects.

  • Sustain the Reaper: Certain abilities, such as Beyond Death, allow you to burn Souls to return from the brink, carrying on as a revenant of your own demise.

  • Shaping Fate: Some skills offer unique interactions, like trading Souls for protection (Soul Conversion) or for strengthening allies through unholy revival.

THE DIRGE

Each Reaper cultivates a personal 【Dirge】—a manifestation of their pact with the departed. The Dirge shapes how their harvested Souls are expressed in combat. As you gain more levels in 【Soulkeeper’s Rite】, you unlock new verses of this requiem, tailoring your style between merciless executioner, battlefield controller, or baleful revenant.

SOUL MANAGEMENT

Managing Souls is the essence of the Reaper’s playstyle. To hoard them is to prepare for overwhelming devastation, but spending them too freely may leave you powerless when death comes calling. Each decision—whether to claim, conserve, or expend—echoes like a bell toll across the battlefield, for both your foes and your allies.

props.class_lore:
Reapers are somber harvesters of souls, walking the thin line between life and death. To the fearful, they are omens of tragedy; to the desperate, they are shepherds who grant the fallen one last purpose. Bound by pacts with the departed, Reapers wield death itself as a weapon.

Though shunned as bearers of ill fate, Reapers command dread and awe in equal measure. By claiming souls from the slain, they conjure dire powers — reviving allies in cursed unlife or striking terror into their foes with shadows of the grave. To befriend one is to walk beside death… and to be their enemy is to hear the dirge of your own demise.
